Contact

Write to us. A person replies.

Not a ticketing system, not a chatbot. Saede is small, which is the one advantage we have here.

Email

What we are genuinely happy to be asked

  • Whether Saede is sensible alongside something you already take. We will tell you honestly, including when the answer is 'ask your pharmacist'.
  • Anything about the ingredients, the doses or the research. If you have read a study we have not, please send it.
  • Anything about your order, your membership, or cancelling it.
  • If you think something on this site is wrong. Especially then. We publish our sources so they can be checked, and that only means something if we correct them when someone finds a mistake.

What we cannot do

We cannot tell you why your hair is falling out, and we cannot interpret your blood results. We are not doctors, and anyone selling you supplements who offers to do either should worry you.

For that, please see a doctor — and if you would like help knowing what to ask for, we wrote this.

Press and partnerships

Same address. Put 'press' in the subject line.

Saede products are food supplements. Food supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet or a healthy lifestyle. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Keep out of reach of young children. Nothing on this website is medical advice, and no Saede product is intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Always consult a doctor or qualified healthcare professional about hair loss, PCOS, or any ongoing symptom, and about any supplement you plan to take alongside prescribed medication. Doses shown are target values pending our manufacturer's technical and regulatory sign-off against EU and AESAN maximum permitted levels.
